audience.text: Python developers who need to inspect, modify, and save Adobe Photoshop document metadata, layers, masks, blend modes, and image resources without rendering.

capabilities.text: PsdImage exposes width, height, channels, bits_per_channel, color_mode, version, is_psb, layer_count, resource_count, compression, image_data_kind, and ICC profile presence.
capabilities.title: Document metadata inspection

capabilities.text: Layer provides name, bounds, opacity, visibility, clipping, blend_mode_key, channels_count, and channel_information; mutations are tracked and preserved on save.
capabilities.title: Layer model access

capabilities.text: BlendMode enum and LayerBlendModeMapper map 4-character PSD keys to enum values for reading and writing blend modes.
capabilities.title: Blend mode handling

capabilities.text: LayerMaskDataShort and LayerBlendingRangesData expose raw length and basic properties; mutations are not supported.
capabilities.title: Mask and blending ranges

capabilities.text: ImageResourcesSection parses known and unknown resources; UnknownResource provides resource_id, name, and raw data; ResourceBlock helpers preserve payloads.
capabilities.title: Image resources parsing

capabilities.text: ImageData parses RLE and ZIP structures without pixel decoding, exposing structure.kind, row_length_field_size, row_byte_counts, compressed_payload_length, and uses_prediction.
capabilities.title: Image data structure parsing

capabilities.text: PsdImage.save preserves all unmodified sections, enabling lossless save-load cycles.
capabilities.title: Byte-exact round-trip saving

capabilities.text: Loading works with streams that do not support seeking, using StreamContainer and BigEndianReader abstractions.
capabilities.title: Non-seekable stream support

limitations.text: ChannelInformation is read-only; writing raises NotImplementedError.
Layer mask and blending ranges data expose raw properties but do not support mutation.
Pixel decoding is not performed; image data is exposed as compressed structures only.
The library does not render or convert to other image formats.

problems_solved.text: Enables non-destructive inspection and modification of .psd/.psb files by exposing document structure, layers, masks, blend modes, and image resources without pixel decoding.
Supports byte-exact round-trip saving by preserving unmodified sections, enabling lossless save-load cycles.
Works with non-seekable streams, allowing use with input sources that do not support random access.
Provides low-level binary utilities for big-endian reading/writing and Pascal string handling required for PSD format compliance.

product_summary.text: Aspose.PSD FOSS for Python is a pure-Python library for reading, inspecting, and saving Adobe Photoshop .psd/.psb files without rendering, using only the Python standard library.

uncertainties: Whether PsdImage.save supports .psb (large document) output format beyond reading it.
Whether the library supports saving to non-seekable streams.
Whether all image resource types are fully parsed or only partially preserved.
Whether layer effects, smart objects, or adjustment layers are fully supported beyond basic layer records.
Whether the library supports saving to formats other than .psd/.psb.
Whether pixel-level operations or compositing are possible.
Whether the library supports PSD templates or other Adobe formats beyond .psd/.psb.
Whether the library supports multi-threaded or concurrent loading/saving.

workflows.name: Load and inspect PSD file
workflows.text: Load a .psd file using PsdImage.load, then inspect dimensions, color mode, compression, layer count, and resources via PsdImage properties.

workflows.name: Enumerate layers and bounds
workflows.text: Iterate over PsdImage.layers to access each Layer, reading name, bounds, opacity, visibility, and blend mode.

workflows.name: Modify layer properties
workflows.text: Update layer name, visibility, opacity, blend mode, or bounds; changes are tracked and preserved during save.

workflows.name: Parse image resources
workflows.text: Access ImageResourcesSection to read known and unknown resources, preserving raw payloads for unknown types.

workflows.name: Inspect image data structure
workflows.text: Read ImageData properties to understand compression structure (RLE/ZIP), row byte counts, and prediction usage without pixel decoding.

workflows.name: Save modified document
workflows.text: Call PsdImage.save to write the document, preserving unmodified sections for byte-exact round-trip.
